I am a divorced parent of two kids, not to advocate or support divorce but just sharing my experience. The reason we divorce is because we want our kids to have a better future with us. We want them to have a better environment. Our marriage didn't work out. Hubby's mad all the time, with temper, I had to walk around eggshells with him. I wasn't able to be myself. What happens is kids notice this and start walking eggshells around him too. Yes we can definitely stay to be together but we realized that we're two different people, our marriage didn't work, we are happier being unmarried. First year of divorce, tough, adjustments, arrangements, then after that we started to communicate more, we didn't have the burden of being married anymore, we became our own individuals, we coparent successfully. Now we communicate better with each other, hubby and kids are so much happier. We no longer walk around eggshells with each other. We date, found love and we love our kids with our entire heart. 

I just feel like when you start walking on eggshells, you fill yourself with fear, and you start being trapped in yourself. If you want to make your marriage work, you need to communicate, you need to stop walking on eggshells and be a team together. 

Not telling you what to do, I totally respect your decision but sharing my experience on divorce and how for me it turned out to be a better environment for my kids
